basics.name: Anand Bhaskaran
basics.label: AI Engineer · Founding Engineer · Production AI Agents · Full-Stack · MBA
basics.summary: Founding-engineer profile built for an Incubation Accelerator: ships AI products from prototype to PMF, then scales them on enterprise infrastructure. At LumApps, owns production AI agents for outbound sales ($4M/quarter approved pipeline forecast, 2x open rates). At Beekeeper, founded the Incubation squad behind Employee Referral ($1.5M+ revenue, $500K ARR) and a 6-week LLM pipeline that killed a $337K vendor contract. Full-stack (Python, Node.js, Vue, React, Java), agentic architectures, cloud-native, three companies founded on the side.

work.name: LumApps
work.summary: Owns AI agent development end-to-end, from production architecture through company-wide rollout. Reports directly to C-level on outcomes, not progress.
highlights: Designed, built, and deployed production AI agents for outbound sales. 2x open rates, 2x approved opportunities, 2 to 3 hours saved per rep per day across SDR and AE teams. Forecast to generate $4M in approved opportunities per quarter; at 25% conversion that is $1M in quarterly revenue.
Owned end-to-end product lifecycle: rapid prototype, architecture (LangChain, FastAPI, GCP), agent runtime, eval harness, production rollout. Cloud-native from day one.
Built AI Brain, an intelligent context layer that unifies conversation data, usage analytics, and notes. Multi-agent system surfacing patterns that drive strategy across product, sales, and CS.

work.name: Beekeeper AG
work.summary: Technical lead who operates like a founding engineer. Owns the problem, designs the solution, ships to prod, stays accountable to the metric. Built AI-powered products used by millions while growing the engineering team around me.
highlights: Founded and led Beekeeper's Incubation team (reporting to CIO). Architected Employee Referral System end-to-end, designed for 99.99% SLA. Became the platform's top revenue channel ($1.5M+ generated, $500K ARR).
Replaced $337K in annual vendor translation costs with an LLM pipeline shipped in 6 weeks. 12K+ assets translated; product team now iterates without external gatekeepers.
Built AI Onboarding Specialist, an intelligent agent guiding 100% of new signups through personalized, high-touch setup at scale. Time-to-first-value reduced without adding headcount.
Designed distributed templating engine that cut customer setup time 90%. Powers 15% of all platform assets for 10M+ users. Microservices architecture, Kafka-backed, cloud-native.

work.name: Tenity
work.summary: Technology panelist and mentor for seed-to-VC stage startups. Evaluates technical architecture and advises on AI adoption, engineering culture, and building systems that scale.
highlights: Evaluated 20+ startups on technical architecture, scalability, and AI readiness to inform seed-to-VC investment decisions.
Mentored Opt Alpha on scaling high-frequency algorithmic trading systems in production.

work.name: Dronistics
work.summary: Founding engineer for an EPFL spin-off autonomous drone delivery startup. Built everything from scratch: architecture, infrastructure, APIs, and the algorithms that made 500+ real-world deliveries possible.
highlights: Shipped end-to-end autonomous drone delivery platform (Vue, Java, PostgreSQL, AWS) from zero. 500+ successful deliveries, each one a live UX test for the system in production.
Built cloud infrastructure and CI/CD pipeline from scratch. Enterprise-grade reliability that enabled Unilever partnership and CES Las Vegas showcase.

work.name: EPFL, Laboratory of Intelligent Systems (Robogen)
work.summary: AI research at the frontier of robotics. Built and scaled Robogen, an open-source platform for co-evolution of robot morphologies and control systems via genetic algorithms. Foundational AI work that underpins my current agentic systems craft.
highlights: Engineered Robogen, an open-source platform for co-evolution of robot bodies and brains via genetic algorithms. Multi-agent autonomous systems where morphology and neural control evolve together.
Migrated simulation pipeline to AWS for large-scale parallel evolution runs. Secured AWS Cloud Credits for Research; work featured on the AWS Public Sector Blog.
Foundational AI experience (optimization, search, fitness landscapes, learning from environment) that informs how I design modern LLM and agentic systems today.

education.institution: Quantic School of Business and Technology

publications.name: I Built an AI Outbound Agent. Here's What Actually Worked.
publications.summary: In-depth case study of building and deploying a production AI outbound sales agent, detailing the architecture, implementation, and real-world outcomes that led to 2x open rates and 2x approved opportunities.

publications.name: Drafted, not sent: how I built the second half of an AI outbound agent.
publications.summary: Follow-up to the AI outbound agent case study, covering the verification and human-in-the-loop layer that made the agent safe to ship to production.

publications.name: Agentic AI: Simple ReAct Agent
publications.summary: Technical tutorial series introducing practical implementation of ReAct (Reasoning + Acting) agents, demonstrating how to build autonomous AI systems that combine reasoning capabilities with actionable decision-making for real-world applications.

publications.name: EPFL designs robots through artificial evolution
publications.summary: RoboGen, an open-source platform from EPFL, uses AWS and artificial evolution (AI) to co-evolve robot bodies and brains. Distributed experiments at scale, powered by AWS cloud.

publications.name: From Infinite Possibilities to Finite Results
publications.publisher: AI for the rest of Us, UK (Talk)
publications.summary: Strategic framework presentation on transforming unlimited AI potential into measurable business outcomes through systematic implementation and practical constraint design.

publications.name: From Idea to Product
publications.summary: Methodology talk on accelerating product development cycles through lean validation, rapid prototyping, and data-driven decision making in startup environments.

publications.name: Microfrontends: Revolutionising Frontend Architecture
publications.summary: Technical deep-dive on how microfrontend architecture enables scalable, team-autonomous development while reducing deployment complexity for enterprise applications.

publications.name: Visualizing AI Embeddings with Heatmap
publications.summary: Data visualization methodology for interpreting high-dimensional AI embeddings through interactive heatmap visualizations for enhanced model interpretability.

awards.title: Appreciation from John T. Chambers (ex-CEO, Cisco Systems)
awards.summary: Recognized for contributions to strategic projects within Cisco's ecosystem

awards.title: TI India Analog Design Contest Winner

projects.name: PulseView - AI Market Intelligence
projects.description: Built for my own trading portfolio first: a platform that explains its signals, not just shows them. Retail traders deserve the same explainable analysis that institutions pay for.
highlights: Real-time market analysis via AI agents that generate and justify trading signals using technical and news-based data.
Opened to retail traders after self-validating. Now serving live users with real-time market feeds.

projects.name: Proplab - AI Real Estate Tools
projects.description: Property inspections run on paper, clipboards, and WhatsApp photos. Built MVP for a fully digital, image-backed, timestamped inspection protocol that replaces the entire manual workflow.
highlights: Shipped MVP replacing paper-based inspection workflows with structured, image-backed, timestamped records.
Building AI marketing assistant that auto-generates property listings from inspection data. One workflow, zero copy-paste.

projects.name: SwissNRI - Cross-border Fintech Platform
projects.description: Swiss-Indian families navigating FEMA, DTAA, and Swiss regulations had zero digital help. Just spreadsheets and expensive advisors. Built the first platform addressing this.
highlights: Zero-to-MVP in 3 months. Early users acquired through Swiss-Indian community partnerships.
Customer feedback loops drove 40% uplift in satisfaction. Roadmap owned by what users actually asked for.

_jobApplication.jobDescription: Snyk's Incubation Accelerator is seeking a Staff Incubation Engineer to join our innovative team, building transformative products from the ground up. This is a unique opportunity to operate with the agility of a startup, while leveraging Snyk's extensive infrastructure, customer reach, and industry insights. Hybrid: Zurich / London / Lisbon. Full-stack product development, system architecture for AI applications, end-to-end ownership from rapid prototyping to large-scale deployment. AI Agent Development, cloud-native deployment, agile + CI/CD. Tech: Python, Golang, NodeJS. Agentic/multi-agent architectures.
_jobApplication.notes: Direct match: founding-engineer profile + production AI agents + 0-to-1 incubation track record (Beekeeper Incubation team, Dronistics, 3 founded companies). Zurich-based, role offers Zurich hybrid.
